versionNotes: Initial Newton source and binaries are retained under provenance/initial-newton. Initial failures used the Newton matrix itself for ILU0.

All paired full solves use the separate Picard velocity preconditioner implementation retained under provenance/pre-metadata and the Newton v2 binary. Picard and field-comparison binaries predate the extra preconditioner export but evaluate unchanged equations/fields.

Final block source only separates actual-Jacobian asymmetry metadata from preconditioner-input asymmetry. Final driver additionally records explicit iteration/restart budgets and initial input. Frozen solution and one accepted budget-control state are byte-identical; no numerical equation change.

Historical velocity_matrix_asymmetry_max in pre-metadata separate-preconditioner records describes the preconditioner input, not the Newton Jacobian. Use final-source-checks.json for both distinct quantities.

method.equation: Same conservative RT1 transport/load, P1 cell/face velocity, P1 static pressure, full symmetric viscosity, original geometry and pressure/velocity boundary policies.
method.linearization: J=K_Picard+D_beta C(u)[.]u; absolute-state RHS=f+D_beta C(u)[u]u, equivalent to J delta=-F. Interior 8x8 static elimination is recomputed from J and its RHS.
method.upwindDerivative: Differentiate both advector and transported velocity, including Piola RT1 volume terms, radial internal upwind terms, shared original-face fluxes and outlet transport. Integrate each existing P1 flux on its true sign intervals; zero-flux branch is not a global smoothness assertion.
method.globalization: Native check with the original nonlinear operator for every trial; half squared L2 of all free uncondensed equation components. Alpha=1,1/2,...; Armijo c=1e-4, at most 15 trials including alpha=1. Prescribed face reactions are excluded.
method.normalization: Reference U=L=1, kinematic pressure U^2. The merit uses the existing dimensionless polynomial equations; it is not a universal dimensional norm or a physical accuracy criterion.
method.acceptance: Original maximum internal equation residual, free-face residual and weak divergence <=1e-9, AND accepted full-state coefficient change <=1e-9. Linear relative tolerance 1e-13. These existing research controls are not new product defaults.
method.boundarySeed: Impose actual prescribed P1 velocity traces and one closed-domain gauge shift before the initial residual; this seed is explicitly not a physical solution. Open pressure remains absolute.
method.linearPreconditioner: Keep actual Newton K/RHS and actual pressure coupling for Krylov products and acceptance. Optionally use same-state native Picard velocity matrix for ILU0 only; pressure inverse remains viscous mass approximation. Original ILU0 pivot guards unchanged.
method.candidateSemantics: Newton recovery labels linearized reactions and physicalDiagnostics=false; only original-operator check yields physical residual/energy/force. Failed trials do not replace lastAcceptedIterate; no finalState until all stopping gates pass. physicalCheckpoint remains false.

segments.failure: nonlinear iteration budget exhausted; no final acceptance

timingQualification: Driver wall times include native geometry, seed (Newton), assembly, linear solve, recovery, original-operator checks, subprocess launch and raw result I/O. Picard sheared8 cost includes failed 30-step segment plus completed 6-step continuation. Separate top-level process times are in batch-results.json/extra-results.json; interpreter startup precedes driver clocks. Small local controls are not exclusive, scalable, or universal speed benchmarks; square8 nu=.1 Newton is slower.
manufacturedOutlet: u=(4y(1-y),0), p=8(1-x), nu=.1 and f=(8nu-8,0)=(-7.2,0). This is a forced manufactured control, not an unforced channel benchmark. It validates boundary lifting and absolute pressure on the new route, not old product stencil equivalence.

limitations: Coarse sheared4 nu=.01 still stagnates in actual nonlinear residual even using a dense solve, then exhausts all line-search trials. No steady-root nonexistence or physical branch selection is inferred.
The no-line-search negative control accepts one full step and its next Krylov solve stagnates at relative residual .001751 after 50 restarts; the Picard preconditioner is not universally robust.
Pressure Schur scaling, realistic curved-wall cold starts, absolute wall pressure, geometry/spatial/domain sensitivity and physical qualification remain outstanding.
No product default/API/CLI/App integration, cancellation workflow, full native regression, frontend, packaged App or additional-platform qualification was performed for this research change.
Original Cut-cell geometry, no-penetration boundary semantics and mesh quality gates are not relaxed. A derivative check on 14-cell cut geometry is not a complete curved-wall flow qualification.
Raw failure and accepted fields are preserved. This batch has no confirmed durable cloud copy.
